headline: Mapanuepe Lake Boat Capsize Death Toll Reaches Nine as Last Missing Passenger Is Found
seoTitle: Mapanuepe Boat Capsize Death Toll Reaches 9 | FMB News
seoDescription: All 13 Aeta passengers have been accounted for after the Mapanuepe Lake boat capsize: nine died and four survived.
deck: The Coast Guard recovered the body of the last missing passenger on August 30, ending the four-day search with nine fatalities and four survivors.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The death toll from the Mapanuepe Lake boat capsize in San Marcelino, Zambales, reached nine after responders recovered the body of the final missing passenger on Sunday, August 30.
The Philippine Coast Guard said the 26-year-old woman was found at about 11:20 a.m. after a four-day search. All 13 Aeta passengers have now been accounted for: nine died and four survived.

sections.heading: The search
paragraphs: The boat capsized near the Sunken Church in Barangay Buhawen on August 27 while the group was returning to Sitio Lumibao. Two missing children were recovered on August 29, and the final missing adult was recovered the following day.
Search operations had repeatedly been affected by unfavorable weather and lake conditions.

sections.heading: What authorities know
paragraphs: The passengers were members of an Aeta community and had traveled across the lake for food, medicine, vaccinations and a 4Ps-related activity before returning home.
Accounts said the boat encountered strong winds and rough water. The incident's precise cause remains a matter for authorities to determine rather than an assumption based only on early reports.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The tragedy highlights the risks faced by communities that rely on small boats for routine access to health, social-service and market centers during rapidly changing monsoon conditions.

sections.heading: Status
paragraphs: With the recovery of the last missing passenger, the search phase ended with nine confirmed deaths and four survivors.
